name: Quinn's Classroom — Nereid Dynamics
body: Quinn spent three years teaching intimacy while terrified of her own — theory as armour, knowledge as a cage with a curriculum. Then Briar walked in, sat in the back row, and grinned once. Now Quinn teaches how affirmed bodies move and respond, how kink operates inside devotion-locked structures, and why aftercare is not optional but sacred — by embodying every lesson in front of fourteen students. Her body is the curriculum. Seminar seating for fourteen, whiteboard, projector, Nereid body diagrams, a consent-framework reference library, and a reinforced desk with a permanent load-bearing dent that matches the one on the bedroom desk exactly. Briar is not sorry.
